name: 70_KMH_WHEN_LIGHTS_FLASHING_YELLOW_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. W8-SA111 1230 x 850, R50, 10 / 30. 70 in 280 E, baseline 385, the pair ending 590 from the left (sheet 80 / 510; the 7 itself starts at 72 on the drawing, the font's 70 being 518 wide); 100 gap; km/h 120 E lower case, 460 overall (80 from the right) — k, m, the oblique stroke (a parallelogram on the sheet's ink) and h placed where the sheet draws them. WHEN LIGHTS 120 D baseline 570 (185 below), 1015 overall (110/W 1015 S/105); FLASHING 120 D baseline 745 (105 below), 735 (250/735/245). For 100 km/h locations (see TES 19976); the value is fixed — no variants.
